blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Metal artifacts in postoperative musculoskeletal CT obscure bone–implant and adjacent soft-tissue interfaces. Many metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods require unavailable raw projections or learned models that may shift across scanners and implants. We present VoxelSynth3D, a training-free 3D image-domain framework for reconstructed CT. The framework combines support masking, normalized tissue synthesis, deviation gating, and restricted edge refinement. Detected implant voxels are preserved in the output, while correction targets metal-induced artifacts in the surrounding tissue. We also construct Synthetic CLINIC-Metal, a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource, from no-metal CTPelvic1K volumes with clean targets, metal/artifact masks, fixed seeds, and patient-level splits; 75 unpaired real metal cases receive qualitative/no-reference evaluation only. The operating point was fixed in a near-flat validation basin. With exact-mask oracle localization, all methods share a metal-excluded tissue ROI. On 40 held-out cases, VoxelSynth3D reduced RMSE from 801.48 to 786.18 HU (paired gain 15.30 HU, 95% CI 11.68–19.23), improving every case and exceeding the evaluated 3D Gaussian smoother by 13.58 HU. Clean-edge agreement decreased next to metal but exceeded input beyond 5 mm. Thus, VoxelSynth3D provides case-consistent within-distribution tissue-error reduction with a localized structural tradeoff. Spacing-aware sensitivity retained aggregate broad-region improvement and identified near-metal calibration as a target.
blocks.zh: 术后肌肉骨骼CT中的金属文物模糊的骨头-植株和相邻的软质组织接口. 许多金属文物的减少方法都需要没有原始预测或学习的模型,这些模型可能跨越扫描仪和植入器。 我们提出VoxelSynth3D,这是重建CT的无训练的3D图像域框架. 框架结合了支持遮掩,正常组织合成,偏差引纹,有限边缘精细. 检测到的植入物在输出中保存,而校正则针对周围组织中的金属引起的文物. 我们还从无金属CTPelvic1K体积中制造合成CLINIC-Metal(受控配对的合成评价资源),并配有干净的目标、金属/工艺口罩、固定种子和病人一级分型;75个未配对的真金属病例只获得定性/无参考评价。 操作点固定在一个近膨胀的验证盆地中. 通过精确的mask oracle本地化,所有方法都共享金属排除的组织ROI. 在被搁置的40起案件中,VoxelSynth3D将RMSE从801.48降至786.18 HU(Paired econd 15.30 HU,95% CI 11.68–19.23),每起案件都有所改善,超过评估的3D高斯平滑器13.58 HU. 金属旁边的清洁剂协议减少,但超过5毫米。 因此,VoxelSynth3D通过局部结构权衡,提供与分布组织内部的大小写一致的减量. 认识距离的敏感性保留了总体宽区域的改进,并将近金属校准确定为一个目标。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Computed tomography (CT) is indispensable for postoperative musculoskeletal assessment because it visualizes implant placement, osseointegration, loosening, infection, fracture fixation, and periprosthetic complications. The same hardware also corrupts CT: beam hardening, scatter, and photon starvation produce streaks and dark bands that obscure bone–implant and soft-tissue interfaces [ 1 , 2 ] . As orthopedic hardware becomes more prevalent [ 3 , 4 ] , metal artifact reduction (MAR) is a practical requirement for reliable interpretation.
blocks.zh: 计算造影术(CT)对于术后肌肉骨骼评估是不可或缺的,因为它可视化植入放置,骨骼融合,松散,感染,断裂固定,以及过敏并发症. 同样的硬件也腐蚀了CT:光束硬化、散射和光子饥馑,会产生模糊骨头-植入和软质界面[1,2]的线条和暗带。 随着矫形硬件越来越普遍[3,4],金属文物还原(MAR)是可靠解释的实际要求.

blocks.en: Classical projection-domain methods, including linear interpolation (LI) and normalized MAR (NMAR), are deterministic and physically motivated, but their strongest form assumes raw or scanner-consistent projection data [ 5 , 2 , 6 ] . This assumption is restrictive for retrospective studies, public CT repositories, and multi-institutional datasets where only reconstructed volumes are available. Learning-based MAR, including image-domain CNNs and dual-domain models such as DuDoNet and InDuDoNet, can model nonlinear artifacts when training and deployment conditions match [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . However, these methods depend on training data, acquisition geometry, reconstruction kernels, and synthetic-to-clinical transfer. Reconstructed-volume CT therefore needs MAR methods that are volumetric, localized, interpretable, and evaluable without unavailable raw projections or opaque learned behavior.
blocks.zh: 经典投影领域方法,包括线性插值(LI)和规范的MAR(NMAR),具有决定性和物理动机,但其最强的形式是原始的或扫描仪一致的投影数据[5,2,6]. 这一假设对追溯性研究、公共CT寄存器和多机构数据集是限制性的,只有重建的卷。 基于学习的MAR,包括图像域CNN和DuDoNet和InDuDoNet等双域模型,在培训和部署条件符合[7,8,9,10]时可以模拟非线性文物. 然而,这些方法依赖于训练数据,获取几何,重建内核,以及合成到临床的转移. 因此,重构的量产CT需要量产、局部化、可解释和可评价的MAR方法,没有原始预测或不透明的学习行为。

blocks.en: VoxelSynth3D addresses this gap as a deterministic 3D image-domain framework. Correction is restricted to an implant-adaptive artifact support, where a normalized volumetric tissue prior estimates plausible non-metal attenuation, a deviation gate limits replacement to corrupted voxels, and restricted edge-guided refinement reinjects high-frequency structure only where support and gradients indicate softened anatomy. This design targets the central MAR tradeoff: suppressing streak and dark-band energy while limiting changes to unaffected tissue. Detected implant voxels are preserved in the output, while correction targets metal-induced artifacts in the surrounding tissue. The novelty is system-level: established operators are composed in an implant-adaptive 3D correction whose support, prior, and weights are inspectable, rather than proposed as new filtering primitives.
blocks.zh: VoxelSynth3D作为决定性3D图像域框架来处理这个缺口. 矫正仅限于植入适应性文物支持,即正常的体积组织事先估计可能存在非金属衰减,偏移门限制对腐烂的阴道进行替换,限制边缘制导的精细化只有在支持和梯度表明有软解剖作用的情况下才能重新喷射高频结构。 这一设计针对MAR的中心交易:抑制螺旋和暗带能量,同时限制对未受影响的组织的改变。 检测到的植入物在输出中保存,而校正则针对周围组织中的金属引起的文物. 新颖的是系统层面:已建立的操作员由植入式3D修正组成,其支持,前置和权重可以检查,而不是作为新的过滤原始物提出.

blocks.en: Evaluation is also difficult because real metal CT rarely has paired clean reconstructions. We therefore construct Synthetic CLINIC-Metal , a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource. This synthetic dataset is generated from no-metal CTPelvic1K pelvic CT volumes [ 11 ] , retaining clean targets, corrupted volumes, metal masks, artifact-ROI masks, spacing metadata, and patient-level splits. This enables within-distribution full-reference evaluation on synthetic cases while keeping real CLINIC-metal scans separate for qualitative and no-reference validation. Full-reference evaluation uses one fixed surrounding-tissue ROI after excluding the inserted core. Pseudo-sinogram baselines are included for comparison, but are interpreted as approximate image-domain adaptations rather than scanner-native projection MAR. Learned rows are likewise public-checkpoint transfer tests, not controlled in-domain comparisons.
blocks.zh: 评价也很困难,因为真正的金属CT很少配对干净的重建. 因此,我们构建了合成CLINIC-Metal,一种可控对称合成评价资源。 这个合成数据集来自无金属CTPelvic1K骨盆CT卷[11],保留干净的目标,腐烂的卷,金属口罩,文物-ROI口罩,间隔元数据,以及患者层次的分裂. 这样就可以对合成病例进行内部分配的充分参考评价,同时将真正的CLINIC-金属扫描分开进行定性和无参考验证。 完全参考评价在排除插入的核心后使用一个固定的周围组织ROI. Pseudo-sinogram基线被包括在内进行比较,但被解释为近似图像域适应,而不是扫描-内在投影MAR. 学习的行同样是公共检查点转移测试,不受控制地进行域内比较。

blocks.en: This paper makes four contributions: • Volumetric MAR: adaptive support, normalized tissue synthesis, gated blending, and restricted edge refinement for reconstructed CT. • Controlled paired resource: Synthetic CLINIC-Metal with clean targets, masks, spacing, patient-level splits, and a metal-excluded tissue endpoint. • Comparative evaluation: image-domain filters, pseudo LI/NMAR, learned MAR checkpoint-transfer tests, and component ablations. • Conservative protocol: validation sensitivity, CIs, paired tests, severity, and real no-reference analysis, plus distance, edge, mask, and external stress tests.

blocks.en: On 40 held-out synthetic cases, VoxelSynth3D achieved lower metal-excluded tissue RMSE and higher ROI MSE reduction than the input and evaluated 3D Gaussian smoother, while learned baselines retained higher edge preservation or tissue SSIM in some settings. The effect was case-consistent: every case improved, while clean-target analysis found a true-edge cost immediately next to metal. The claim is therefore within-distribution artifact suppression with a localized structural tradeoff, not anatomical recovery. We do not claim scanner-native projection-domain superiority; instead, we target retrospective settings where only reconstructed CT is available. Figure 1 illustrates the VoxelSynth3D pipeline.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Classical and Projection-Domain MAR
blocks.zh: II-A 传统和预测领域

blocks.en: Metal artifacts arise because high-density objects violate assumptions used by standard CT reconstruction. Linear interpolation replaces corrupted metal traces before filtered backprojection, while NMAR normalizes the sinogram with a prior image before interpolation to reduce discontinuities [ 2 ] . These methods remain clinically relevant because they are simple and interpretable, but they can erase structures crossing the metal trace and introduce new streaks. Their strongest form requires access to scanner projection data; when only reconstructed images are available, pseudo-sinogram baselines become approximate and should be interpreted cautiously.
blocks.zh: 金属文物的产生是因为高密度物体违反了标准CT重建所使用的假设. 线性插图在过滤回投影之前取代腐烂的金属痕迹,而NMAR则在插图之前将先成像法正常化,以减少不连续[2]. 这些方法在临床上仍然具有相关性,因为它们简单易懂,但可以抹去跨越金属痕量的结构,引入新的螺纹. 其最强的形态要求访问扫描仪投影数据;当只有重建的图像可用时,伪同位素基线会变得近似,应当谨慎解释.

blocks.en: II-B Learning-Based and Hybrid MAR
blocks.zh: II-B 基于学习和混合的MAR

blocks.en: Learning-based MAR has progressed from image-domain convolutional networks to dual-domain approaches that jointly process sinograms and images. DuDoNet introduced a dual-domain formulation for CT MAR [ 8 ] ; InDuDoNet and InDuDoNet+ further unfolded interpretable dual-domain iterations [ 9 , 10 ] . Dictionary-style unrolled models such as ACDNet also use learned sparse priors for MAR [ 12 ] . These models can be powerful when the deployment domain matches the training distribution, but supervised learning requires paired or synthetic data and may be sensitive to scanner geometry, implant appearance, and reconstruction kernels. Explainability concerns in medical AI [ 13 ] and robustness concerns under distribution shift [ 14 , 15 ] motivate methods whose correction support, blending weights, and anatomical priors are inspectable. VoxelSynth3D follows this direction while remaining fully image-domain and volumetric.
blocks.zh: 基于学习的MAR已经从图像域演化网络发展为双域方法,共同处理天线图和图像. DuDoNet引入了CT MAR [8]的双域配方;InDuDoNet和InDuDoNet+进一步展开可解释的双域配方[9,10]. 词典风格的无卷模式,如ACDNet,也为MAR[12]使用所学的稀有前科. 当部署域匹配训练分布时,这些模型可以强大,但受监督的学习需要配对或合成数据,并且可能对扫描仪几何,植入外观,重建内核敏感. 医疗AI[13]中的解释性关切和分布转变中的稳健性关切[14,15]激励了可检查其矫正支持、混合重量和解剖前科的方法。 VoxelSynth3D遵循这个方向,同时保持完全的图像域和卷曲.

blocks.en: Commercial scanner MAR and orthopedic MAR workflows are clinically useful when available [ 1 ] , but reconstructed-image methods remain relevant for retrospective archives, public datasets, and multi-site studies where raw projections, vendor reconstructions, and kernel details are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 商业扫描仪MAR和矫形MAR工作流程在可用[1]时在临床上有用,但重建的图像方法对于追溯档案、公共数据集和多站点研究仍然相关,因为没有原始预测、供应商重建和内核细节。

blocks.en: The 2025 AAPM CT-MAR Grand Challenge provides a standardized 2D multi-anatomy benchmark, while its hybrid database combines clinical images, virtual metals, and XCIST/CatSim physics [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Synthetic CLINIC-Metal is complementary rather than a replacement: it supplies paired 3D pelvis volumes and spatial masks for localization analysis.

blocks.en: IV-B Artifact-Model Sensitivity and Scope
blocks.zh: IV-B 人工活性-模型敏感性和范围

blocks.en: To assess robustness beyond the primary controlled distribution, we evaluated the fixed method with a spacing-aware artifact model that incorporates pixel size when converting Radon sums to Beer–Lambert integrals. The evaluation used the first synthetic variant (index 00) from each of 21 validation patients, with criteria defined during the initial validation-only pilot and then held fixed: ≥ 5 % \geq 5\% broad-RMSE improvement, ≤ 5 % \leq 5\% interface worsening, local-SSIM loss ≤ 0.01 \leq 0.01 , and ≥ 75 % \geq 75\% of cases within a 10% interface margin. Importantly, broad-region error reduction remained evident under this changed artifact model: the mean method/input RMSE ratio was 0.891, with improvement in 13/21 cases. The sensitivity was concentrated near the metal interface, where the 2–5-mm RMSE ratio was 2.772 and local SSIM changed by − 0.150 -0.150 . Excluding two cases under the fixed QC rule produced similar results (0.889/2.726; 0/19 within the interface margin). This analysis therefore shows that the broad-region correction effect is retained on average under altered artifact physics while identifying the immediate peri-metal region as the principal target for further physics calibration and refinement.

blocks.en: IV-C Real CLINIC-Metal Validation
blocks.zh: IV-C 真正的CLINIC-金属验证

blocks.en: The real CLINIC-Metal subset contains 75 volumes with metallic implants but no paired clean reconstructions. We therefore use it only for qualitative and no-reference evaluation. Metrics on these cases measure how much a method changes artifact-like regions and how smooth the correction is across slices; they do not establish full-reference image quality.
blocks.zh: 真正的CLINIC-Metal子集包含75卷,带有金属植入物,但没有配对的清洁重建. 因此,我们只利用它来进行定性和无参考评价。 关于这些案件的衡量尺度衡量一种方法在多大程度上改变了类似文物的区域,以及校正如何平滑地跨切片;这些测量尺度没有确立完整的参考图像质量。

blocks.en: IV-D Comparators and Ablations
blocks.zh: 四-D 比较和符号

blocks.en: Synthetic full-reference evaluation includes the uncorrected input, a descriptive slice-wise 2D Gaussian control, 3D Gaussian filtering, pseudo LI-MAR/NMAR, DICDNet, InDuDoNet, InDuDoNet+, an adaptive-prior VoxelSynth3D ablation, the proposed edge-guided VoxelSynth3D method, and a multi-scale residual-matching extension. Pseudo LI/NMAR use approximate pseudo-sinograms rather than scanner raw projections. DICDNet and InDuDoNet-family models are public pretrained checkpoints applied as available-domain stress-test comparators, so their results reflect deployment transfer rather than the maximum possible performance after in-domain retraining. We therefore label learned rows as public-checkpoint transfer tests. CPU wall-clock times include method/wrapper execution and metric bookkeeping and are implementation timings, not a controlled accelerator benchmark. We report the numerical validation-minimum edge setting for transparency but do not treat it as proposed. Real no-reference evaluation includes 2D median, 3D Gaussian, and the three VoxelSynth3D configurations. All correction parameters remain fixed. Eq. (5) adds parameter-free implant-core pass-through. Exact-mask oracle experiments isolate correction under accurate localization, whereas automatic HU localization assesses the current heuristic end-to-end pipeline.

blocks.en: IV-F External Stress Test
blocks.zh: IV-F 外部压力测试

blocks.en: To assess behavior on an independent reconstructed-image dataset, we applied VoxelSynth3D without parameter adjustment to all 29 public AAPM CT-MAR scoring images. Because the challenge data are 2D, each image was replicated across five isotropic slices to satisfy the volumetric input requirement, and the center slice of the resulting output was evaluated. Reference images and scoring masks were used only for evaluation and were not available during inference, mask construction, or adaptation. This experiment is therefore interpreted as an external reconstructed-image stress test rather than a native 3D or clinical validation.
blocks.zh: 为了评估独立重建的图像数据集上的行为,我们在没有参数调整的情况下将VoxelSynth3D应用于所有29个公开的APM CT-MAR评分图像. 由于挑战数据是2D,因此每个图像被复制到五个异色片中,以满足体积输入要求,结果输出的中心片段得到了评价. 参考图像和评分口罩仅用于评价,在推论、面罩构造或改造期间不可用。 因此,这一实验被解释为外部重建的图像应激测试,而不是本土的3D或临床验证.

blocks.en: V Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: The evaluation addresses three questions: whether error reduction survives metal exclusion, how structural cost varies with distance from metal, and how mask extent affects both the target score and unaffected tissue. These precede external and real-data analyses.

blocks.en: V-A Full-Reference Synthetic Evaluation
blocks.zh: V-A 全面参考合成评价

blocks.en: Table III summarizes held-out performance. To evaluate correction of the surrounding tissue independently of implant-core handling, all image-quality metrics are reported on a common metal-excluded tissue ROI. This distinction is important because metal occupies only 0.218% of the original ROI yet accounts for 41.2% of VoxelSynth3D’s aggregate squared-error reduction. The metal-excluded endpoint therefore focuses on artifact correction in adjacent tissue; metal-containing RMSE/EPI provide complementary sensitivity measures.

On the metal-excluded tissue ROI, VoxelSynth3D achieved an RMSE of 786.18 HU, compared with 801.48 HU for the input and 799.75 HU for 3D Gaussian filtering. The corresponding paired gains were 15.30 HU (95% CI 11.68–19.23) and 13.58 HU (10.07–17.40), respectively. The 1.9% reduction was observed in all 40 held-out cases, with gains of 13.73, 17.21, and 12.66 HU across low-, medium-, and high-severity groups. These results show a consistent surrounding-tissue benefit that is not reproduced by Gaussian smoothing.
Structural metrics provide complementary information. VoxelSynth3D achieved the highest tissue-ROI EPI (0.338), while InDuDoNet showed the highest SSIM and residual-error variance reduction. VoxelSynth3D had a residual-error variance reduction of − 0.053 -0.053 . Because RMSE, variance reduction, and EPI capture different aspects of reconstruction error, they are interpreted jointly. In particular, EPI reflects gradient agreement over the broader tissue ROI, whereas clean-edge F1 evaluates target-defined anatomical edges by distance from metal. Complementary full-ROI RMSE/EPI values were 785.43/0.542 for VoxelSynth3D, 811.86/0.581 for input, 802.21/0.690 for pseudo LI-MAR, and 803.10/0.687 for InDuDoNet. Body SSIM was also stable relative to input (0.866 versus 0.865). Figure 4 shows case-consistent tissue-error gains across distance bands and exposes the localized edge tradeoff.

blocks.en: V-B Ablation, Severity, and Metric Tradeoff
blocks.zh: V-B 严重性和量子权衡

blocks.en: The ablation and severity panels sharpen interpretation. Figure 5 A shows that most of the observed full-ROI improvement comes from the volumetric prior, deviation gating, and adaptive support; edge-guided refinement is a small endpoint improvement that keeps the method training-free. VoxelSynth3D-MS improves full-ROI EPI (0.559 versus 0.542) but slightly worsens RMSE (785.72 versus 785.43 HU) and nearly doubles runtime, so it remains an ablation. Figure 5 B shows the strongest full-ROI MSE reduction in high artifact-size cases (9.67% versus 3.42% for pseudo LI-MAR and 3.49% for InDuDoNet). For continuity, these metal-containing analyses remain secondary sensitivity evidence.

blocks.en: The metal-excluded spatial analysis refines interpretation near the implant. Across 40 cases at 2–5 mm, mean RMSE fell from 858.90 to 244.84 HU while mean clean-edge F1 fell from 0.548 to 0.352; paired change was − 0.197 -0.197 [95% CI − 0.253 , − 0.142 -0.253,-0.142 ]. Precision/recall 0.599/0.278 shows that retained edges were usually genuine, but many true edges were missed. Two complete misses were scored as zero F1. At 5–10/10–20 mm, F1 exceeded input by 0.089 [0.011,0.162]/0.132 [0.096,0.170]. Edge loss is therefore concentrated where correction is strongest. Lower RMSE carries a localized structural cost and does not establish recovery. Edge guidance partly improved over VoxelSynth3D-A (+0.017 EPI, +0.012 SSIM) at 1.61 × \times runtime. blocks.en: V-C Mask Dependence and Collateral Modification
blocks.zh: V-C 遮盖依赖性和抵押权修改

blocks.en: Table IV separates correction tolerance from localization accuracy. Controlled 1–2-mm perturbations remained below the 801.48-HU input endpoint, indicating tolerance to modest boundary error. Automatic HU localization was much broader (precision 0.285): it improved target-ROI RMSE to 767.99 HU by modifying substantially more unaffected tissue.

blocks.en: For the exact-mask oracle, only 0.082% of outside-ROI voxels changed by more than 50 HU, versus 1.04% with automatic HU localization; outside-ROI RMSE rose by 4.62 and 39.22 HU, respectively. A larger correction region can therefore improve target RMSE while damaging normal tissue outside it. This independently shows why artifact-ROI RMSE is insufficient alone; we interpret it with clean-edge preservation and outside-ROI change. Boundary perturbations support correction-stage tolerance, not end-to-end localization accuracy. Accurate HU localization remains a deployment challenge.
blocks.zh: 对于精确的面具甲骨文来说,只有0.082%的外置ROI voxels变化超过50HU,相对于1.04%的自动HU本地化;外置ROI RMSE分别上升4.62和39.22HU. 因此,较大的校正区可以改善目标RMSE,同时破坏其外的正常组织. 这独立地说明了为什么文物-ROI RMSE单靠它是不够的;我们用清洁的保存和ROI外的变化来解释它. 边界扰动支持校正阶段耐受性,而不是端到端的定位精度. 准确的HU本地化仍然是一个部署挑战.

blocks.zh: V-D 验证稳定性和外部/真实数据范围

Its numerical minimum (80, 1.5 mm, 0.65; 779.29 HU) was only 0.10 HU below the conservative reported setting (85, 1.0 mm, 0.45; 779.39 HU); on test data the difference was 0.09 HU. The same full-ROI trend persisted across metal-burden strata. The uncertainty/profile analyses showed decreasing gain-CI width with sample size and the expected RMSE–EPI/SSIM tradeoff.

blocks.en: On 75 real CLINIC-Metal cases, no clean target is available. Input-relative MAC change, inter-slice consistency, and runtime characterize how strongly and smoothly a method changes a volume, not whether it is anatomically correct; smoothing can improve these indicators. The cases therefore establish qualitative plausibility only, and reader- and task-based validation is required for diagnostic claims.

blocks.en: V-F Limitations
blocks.zh: V-F 限制

blocks.en: Synthetic artifacts cannot capture every scanner, protocol, implant, and reconstruction-kernel effect, and this pelvis-focused evaluation resource does not establish generalization to other anatomies or implant geometries. The primary model supports controlled comparison; spacing-aware sensitivity retained broad-region gains but showed reduced near-metal robustness. The exact-mask oracle isolates correction; automatic HU localization over-includes high-HU anatomy. Adapted pseudo LI/NMAR and learned checkpoints may not represent their strongest scanner-native or in-domain implementations. Finally, VoxelSynth3D lowers artifact-ROI error at the cost of lower full-ROI EPI than some comparators, motivating better separation of anatomical edges from residual streaks. Blinded radiologist scoring remains the key clinical validation step; AAPM and real input-relative metrics cannot establish diagnostic benefit.
blocks.zh: 合成文物无法捕捉到每一个扫描仪,协议,植入物,以及重建-内核效应,而这种以骨盆为重点的评价资源也无法建立对其他解剖或植入地美图的概括. 主要模型支持有控制的比较;对间隔的敏感度保留了广泛的区域收益,但显示近金属强度降低。 精确的任务甲骨文隔离校正;自动HU本地化过度包含高HU解剖学. 改编的伪LI/NMAR和学习的检查站可能不是其最强的扫描器本土或域内实施。 最后,VoxelSynth3D降低了文物-ROI的误差,其代价比一些比较国更低的全ROI EPI,从而促使解剖边缘与残迹更好地分离. 失明的放射学家评分仍然是临床验证的关键步骤;AAPM和真正的输入相对度量衡不能确定诊断效益.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: We presented VoxelSynth3D, an interpretable 3D image-domain MAR framework for reconstructed CT without raw projections, with Synthetic CLINIC-Metal as a controlled paired synthetic evaluation resource. With the exact-mask oracle, it consistently reduced surrounding-tissue error versus input and the evaluated Gaussian smoother. Its support, prior, and weights are inspectable; outside-support voxels remain unchanged; targeted audits measure its edge tradeoff and localization limitations. Its limited robustness near metal under the spacing-corrected artifact model bounds this result. Real CLINIC-metal evidence remains qualitative/no-reference. VoxelSynth3D is therefore a training-free, inspectable reconstructed-volume correction framework with measurable within-distribution benefits and limitations, not a replacement for scanner-native MAR. Calibrated simulation and blinded task assessment are needed for external and clinical effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了VoxelSynth3D,这是一个可解释的三维图像域MAR框架,用于在不进行原始预测的情况下重建CT,其中合成CLINIC-Metal为可控对称合成评价资源. 以精确的mask oracle,它一贯减少周围的问题错误与输入,评价的高斯平滑. 其支持、先验和权重可以检查;外部支持的排泄物保持不变;目标明确的审计衡量其边缘权衡和本地化限制。 在经过间距校正的文物模型下,它靠近金属的强度有限,从而限制了这一结果。 真正的CLINIC-金属证据仍然是定性/无参考。 VoxelSynth3D因此是一个无培训的,可检查的重建量校正框架,具有可测量的内部分配效益和局限性,而不是取代扫描器-本地MAR. 外部和临床效果需要校准模拟和盲目任务评估。
